name: Can I offset HOA fees through rental income, and how does this affect my cash flow?

mainEntity.name: Can I offset HOA fees through rental income, and how does this affect my cash flow?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you aim to offset HOA fees and all other operating expenses through your rental income. A positive cash flow means your rental income exceeds these expenses, providing a profit. Conversely, if your rental income doesn't cover all costs, including HOA fees, you'll have a negative cash flow, meaning you're losing money monthly. Kelby Contreras can assist you in analyzing current market rents in areas like Coral Gables or Sunny Isles Beach to project realistic cash flow before you make a purchasing decision.
acceptedAnswer.description: You can offset HOA fees with rental income. Positive cash flow occurs when income covers all expenses; negative means a monthly loss.
